name: Timer
description: Started System.Timers.Timer objects never stopped or disposed; each Elapsed handler's target stays alive through the runtime's timer queue (sprint 2.6).
notes: No application field holds the timers: the runtime's timer queue (TimerQueue.Instances, then each queue's timer list) holds every started timer, its TimerQueueTimer's callback targets the System.Timers.Timer, whose Elapsed handler targets the TimerTarget. A System.Threading.Timer nothing references is finalized and stops, so it does not leak this way. The timer detector must name TimerTarget, not System.Timers.Timer; the event handler detector must not name System.Timers.Timer's Elapsed event.
